transcript.answer: Otto's `EscalationTrigger` type has 10 members, per FR-002 of the support-agent-escalation spec. They are: `tms_unavailable`, `tms_timeout`, `no_tool_for_question`, `customer_asked_for_human`, `out_of_scope_change_request`, `tool_budget_exhausted`, `model_call_failed`, `blocked_consequential_call`, `tool_crashed` and `customer_scope_conflict`. The FR-002 text was cut off in the search result I read. The final item in the list was introduced with "and", so I believe the list is complete. Later changes to the spec could have added more.

judgements.reason: The answer correctly gives ten triggers and lists all of them, but it leaves out the document conflicts (#151, #178 and RD-01) and the undecided needs_manual_tms_check, which the gold answer treats as essential.
